# Compresso — Full Reference for AI Indexing

> Free browser-native image optimizer and 3.6 KB JavaScript library (compresso.js).
> 100% client-side — images never leave the device until the user uploads them.

## Product URLs
- Web app: https://izaias.xyz/compresso
- Marketing: https://compresso.izaias.xyz
- Documentation: https://compresso.izaias.xyz/docs/
- FAQ: https://compresso.izaias.xyz/en/faq/
- Comparison: https://compresso.izaias.xyz/en/compare/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/compresso.js
- GitHub: https://github.com/iziuqo/compresso

## Supported languages
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified)
Locale URLs: /en/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /it/, /pt-br/, /zh-hans/

## Key differentiators
1. Zero server upload — privacy by architecture, verifiable in DevTools Network tab
2. HEIC/HEIF input in browser — native on Safari, WASM decoder elsewhere
3. Never-bigger guarantee — lossy output never exceeds source file size
4. 3.6 KB gzipped core, zero required dependencies
5. Web Worker parallel batching via compresso.js/pool
6. Auto format: AVIF → WebP → JPEG per browser capability
7. Target max file size via maxSizeMB binary search

## FAQ (summary)

Q: How do I compress an image in the browser before uploading?
A: Read from input, pass to compress(file, { quality, maxWidth }), upload result.file. Client-side only.

Q: How do I convert HEIC to JPEG/WebP in JavaScript?
A: Pass .heic file to compress(file, { format: 'auto' }). Decodes HEIC locally, outputs web format.

Q: Why did my compressed image get bigger than the original?
A: Compresso caps lossy output at source size; reduces resolution instead of inflating on inefficient re-encodes.

Q: Does it need a server?
A: No. 100% Canvas API client-side.

Q: React, Vue, Next.js?
A: Yes — framework-agnostic. Examples in repository.

Q: Parallel batch without blocking UI?
A: Import createPool from compresso.js/pool — Web Worker pool with main-thread fallback.

Q: Strict CSP — HEIC fails?
A: Usually missing wasm-unsafe-eval in script-src or worker-src for pool.

## vs competitors (browser libraries)
| Feature | compresso.js | compressorjs | browser-image-compression | pica |
| HEIC input | Yes | No | No | No |
| AVIF output | Yes | No | No | No |
| Never bigger | Yes | No | No | No |
| Bundle min+gzip | ~3.8 KB | 4.6 KB | 19.6 KB | 15.7 KB |

## vs server tools (TinyPNG, iLoveIMG)
Compresso never uploads images. Server tools send files to third-party infrastructure.
